resolution: Decal IMAGE nodes now ship and render in the compiled no-V8 game via the content-addressed asset store (V29). Bake side: new compile/decalAssets.ts sink — packDecalDoc interns each visible image node's file (readFileBase64 cwd-relative, the same path the editor's Image primitive loads; sha256 is the address so identical content ships ONE blob; keys count from 3001, manifest kind 11, 8MB cap) and the packed image record carries the manifest key (u32 assetKey | f32 borderRadius | u16 srcLen | src-for-diagnostics). The sink threads buildWorldInstances → createHmscMapfile → bakeGameFile, which ships each payload as a manifest entry + tape-envelope asset (embed:false, the player-model precedent) and declares the keys in map.refs so installAndValidate gates them. Loader side: constructor.zig reads every kind-11 manifest asset into Scene.decal_assets; decal_raster NODE_IMAGE stbi-decodes and bilinear-blits into the node rect with the same rounded-rect SDF coverage rect fills use (borderRadius + opacity honored), before the global 180° flip. Every failure mode (empty src, unreadable, oversized, invalid transport, undecodable, missing payload) degrades to a warn + skipped node — never a failed bake or construct. Proof: a synthetic gamefile carrying a real PNG as an embedded kind-11 blob rendered the image ON a box face in the headless loader with zero skip warns (rounded corners visible); rjit game shot stays GREEN on the real world; suites decalAssets 2/2, decalPack 6/6, worldGeometry 7/7, worldColliders 4/4 all pass.
